xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-alef-generated-b.description: Xberg specifics on top of the shared Alef workflow: generated output locations, alef.toml sections, core edits that break a regen, FFI bridge JSON marshalling. Use when editing bindings, extractors or trait methods, or regenerating.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-api-server-mcp.description: Xberg REST API server (axum routes, middleware, cache) and MCP protocol surface. Use when changing an API endpoint, server startup, the cache endpoints, or MCP tools.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-xberg-batch-extr.description: Use when extracting from many files at once with shared config, bounded parallelism, per-file overrides, and error recovery. Covers the `batch` command, `--file-configs`, `--max-concurrent`, and output layout.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-benchmark-workfl.description: Run, diagnose or change Xberg extraction benchmarks, quality scoring, benchmark fixtures and ground truth. Use for the Benchmarks workflow or benchmark-harness work, not ordinary unit tests.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-xberg-chunking.description: Use when splitting extracted text into chunks for LLM context windows or RAG ingestion. Covers chunk size, overlap, markdown/yaml/semantic chunkers, tokenizer-based sizing, and the standalone `chunk` command.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-chunking-embeddi.description: Xberg text chunking (ChunkerType, ChunkingConfig wire names), embedding generation and RAG integration. Use when changing chunking or embeddings code or config.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-config-loading-p.description: How Xberg resolves configuration: CLI and server/MCP precedence, config file walk-up, inline JSON merge, CLI overrides, silent no-op traps. Use when adding a config flag or env var or a setting does not take effect.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-crate-structure.description: Xberg workspace layout: version source of truth, workspace members and excluded crates, packages/, tools/, ignore-file allowlists for a new member. Use when navigating the repo, deciding where code belongs, or adding a crate.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-xberg-extracting.description: Use when extracting keywords (YAKE/RAKE) from documents — and, secondarily, when detecting document language or generating embeddings for RAG and search. Covers the keyword config (and its feature gating), `--detect-language`, and the standalone `embed` command with real flags.
Use when extracting tabular data from PDFs, spreadsheets, or images. Covers layout-aware table detection, table model selection, output formats (markdown / JSON cells), and known limits.
Use when extracting text from scanned PDFs, photographed pages, or images that have no embedded text layer. Covers OCR backends, language packs, force-OCR, and performance tuning.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-extraction-pipel.description: Xberg core extraction orchestration: cache semantics, extractor fallback, post-processing, concurrency defaults, format-wide quality invariants. Use for pipeline changes or diagnosis, not a single parser's syntax.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-feature-flag-pol.description: Xberg's own Cargo features in crates/xberg: ORT-free targets (WASM, Android), tract and type-only variants, PDF backend, aggregates, CI parity guard, build profiles. Use when adding or debugging a feature or a target build.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-format-specific-.description: Per-format extraction workflows in Xberg (Office XML, PDF, archives and others): parsers, security budgets, metadata helpers. Use when changing or adding a format extractor.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-mime-detection-r.description: Xberg MIME detection and extractor routing in core/mime.rs: the FORMATS registry, path and bytes detection, priority selection, adding a format. Use when a file routes to the wrong extractor or a format is added.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-ocr-pipeline-and.description: Change or evaluate Xberg OCR backends, preprocessing, caching, page acceptance, geometry, hOCR, table reconstruction or cross-backend quality. Use for OCR behavior and A/B quality work, not plain PDF text.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-pdf-backends.description: Change or diagnose Xberg PDF extraction: native/Pdfium backend selection, rendering sessions, encrypted documents, OCR fallback, backend capability gaps. Use for PDF engine work, not generic image OCR.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-xberg-picking-a-.description: Use when choosing an output format for extracted documents — plain text, markdown, djot, HTML, JSON, or DocTags. Maps consumer (LLM, parser, archive) to the right `--format` / `--content-format` pair.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-plugin-architect.description: Design, implement or diagnose Xberg plugin traits, typed registries, priority collisions, lifecycle, native extractors and Alef-generated Python plugin bridges. Use for plugin-system work, not ordinary parsing.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-polyrepo-boundar.description: Decide which xberg-io repository owns a cross-repository fix or API and coordinate compatible changes across sibling repos. Use when work spans sibling repositories, not for a self-contained Xberg edit.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-test-corpus.description: The test_documents fixture corpus (submodule, bucket-fetched, not committed): read_test_fixture, missing fixtures, A/B controls, push order. Use before Rust tests on a fresh clone or when a fixture is missing.

xberg-io-xberg-ai-rulez-wasm-constraints.description: WASM build constraints for crates/xberg-wasm: wasm-target features, sync-only internal APIs, SyncExtractor, HTML size limit, size-optimized build. Use when building for wasm32 or debugging WASM build or runtime failures.

xberg-io-xberg-xberg.description: Extract text, tables, metadata, and images from 107 document formats (PDF, Office, images, HTML, email, archives, academic) using Xberg. Use when writing code that calls Xberg APIs in Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Rust, or CLI. Covers installation, extraction (sync/async), configuration (OCR, chunking, output format), batch processing, error handling, and plugins.
